phases.name: Tenant-qualified entries read: server and console

steps.name: Entries read carries the owning tenant with per-tenant running balances
criteria: Unscoped entries read returns each entry paired with its owning tenant, grouped by tenant
Tenant-scoped entries read returns only that tenant's entries, each naming that tenant
Running balance restarts for each tenant when account ids collide
Single-tenant running balances are numerically unchanged; all existing tests stay green
steps.implementation_notes: rca.md §3 steps 1-3. Tenant-qualified entry type on the EntriesFor port (domain.Entry untouched, ADR-007); postgres selects tenant_id in both branches, unscoped order tenant_id, recorded_at, sequence; TracedEntry gains TenantID; runningBalances resets sum and currency per tenant. Also GREEN: TestGetEntries_UnscopedNamesEachEntrysTenantAndRestartsTheRunningBalance, TestGetEntries_ScopedNamesItsOwnTenantAndNeverFoldsAnother, TestProperty_GetEntries_RunningBalancesAreIndependentPerTenantWhenAccountIdsCollide. App fake (fakes_test.go ~345): EntriesFor returns the tenant-qualified type from store.entriesWithTenantIn(scope) filtered to accountID, honours scope, groups by tenant in first-seen order, keeps each tenant's own order. Pact provider fake (pact_provider_test.go ~453): same return type, honours scope, derives tenant from accounts[entry.AccountID()].TenantID(). Only callers of EntriesFor are usecases.go and the two fakes (grep-verified); handlers.go uses TracedEntry so keep it compiling (entriesToWire unchanged here). Both fakes are existing test-support files whose signature must change; do not weaken authored tests. Foreground tests only: go test -count=1. Copy libpact_ffi.so to /tmp before testing internal/adapters/http. Contract shape: pure-function (read-only; no mutation).

steps.name: Entries HTTP response names each tenant; operator narrows by tenant
criteria: Every entry in the response includes tenant_id for all callers
Operator read with tenant_id returns only that tenant's entries with correct running balances
Operator narrowing to a tenant lacking the account is refused as account_not_found
Tenant key naming another or unprovisioned tenant is refused as account_not_found; naming its own id behaves as naming none
Single-tenant ledger reads as before apart from the additive tenant_id
steps.scenario_name: The unscoped read names the tenant behind every entry and lists each tenant's entries together
steps.implementation_notes: rca.md §3 step 4. entriesToWire emits tenant_id for all callers. @sizing-review-needed (8 scenarios, kept as one step; informational). getEntriesHandler scope rule (03c scenarios 5-7), explicit: (a) context scope Unscoped (operator) and ?tenant_id=T: use ScopedToTenant(T); (b) context scope ScopedToTenant(A) and ?tenant_id equals A: behave as if absent; (c) context scope ScopedToTenant(A) and ?tenant_id any other value, including an unprovisioned id: refuse with account_not_found, return no rows. trialBalanceScopeFromQuery (handlers.go:802-808) must NOT be called on the entries path: it unconditionally turns any ?tenant_id= into ScopedToTenant(id), which would let a tenant key switch tenants. Test files authored by the acceptance designer must not be weakened. If the milestone-02 @console-compat scenario or any byte-identical or CI-gated scenario goes red, STOP and escalate to the orchestrator; do not amend or weaken it in-step. The milestone-03b feature-file change is comment-only (lines 17-18 reworded), already authored; commit it with this step. Un-pend one scenario at a time (tag @pending removed; keep @fix-unscoped-entries-tenant-merge): 1 unscoped names tenant; 2 running balance restarts; 3 Outline narrowing; 4 narrowing to tenant lacking account; 5 tenant reads own; 6 tenant names itself; 7 Outline tenant cannot read another; 8 single-tenant ledger. Only permitted feature-file edit is removing @pending; harness files (world.go, steps_multitenancy_test.go, domain_types.go) are already authored and must not change. Run: LEDGEROPS_AT_TAGS="@fix-unscoped-entries-tenant-merge" go test -count=1 -v ./tests/acceptance/multitenancy (expect 8 scenarios, 10 runs). Then run milestone-02 console-compat and brief CI-gated byte-identical scenarios. Pact provider verification may not yet cover the new interaction (added in 01-03). Foreground tests only; copy libpact_ffi.so to /tmp before testing internal/adapters/http. Contract shape: pure-function (read-only); unbounded-preservation scenarios assert refusal leaves data unchanged.

steps.name: Console drill-down is tenant-qualified; consumer pact and provider state cover it
criteria: Drift rows carry tenant id; a drift row without one is a fetch failure
Verdict table shows a Tenant column and keeps two tenants' same-named drifting accounts as separate rows
Selecting a row fetches that tenant's entries for the account; entry trace shows the tenant
Entries fetch without a tenant sends no tenant query; with one it is URL-encoded
Provider verifies the regenerated consumer pact, including the tenant-narrowed entries interaction
steps.scenario_name: two drifted treasury rows from different tenants (ConsoleApp, DriftTable, EntryTrace, apiClient and apiClient.pact tests: 15 tests currently failing, at 13 locations listed in notes)
steps.implementation_notes: rca.md §3 step 5. parseDriftRow maps tenant_id to tenantId (required); fetchEntries(accountId, tenantId?) appends URL-encoded ?tenant_id= only when present; DriftTable adds Tenant column, keys by tenant+account, calls onSelectAccount(accountId, tenantId); ConsoleApp selection and staleness checks compare both; EntryTrace takes tenantId prop, shows it, fallback URL ends ?tenant_id=<id>. No client-side filtering. Test files authored by the acceptance designer must not be weakened. The 15 failing vitest tests (13 locations; some Outline/property locations expand to more than one case): apiClient.test.ts:136, 154, 204, 224; DriftTable.test.tsx:49, 67, 75, 87; EntryTrace.test.tsx:67, 79; ConsoleApp.test.tsx:161, 178; apiClient.pact.test.ts:152. Pact provider (pact_provider_test.go): add state "tenant tnt_acme holds account treasury with one entry" — insert domain.Tenant tnt_acme into store.tenants; as that tenant's key open treasury plus a funding account and post one transfer (pattern: seedAccountWithOneEntry). Interaction GET /accounts/treasury/entries?tenant_id=tnt_acme with operator key expects tenant_id on each entry; existing verdict interaction expects tenant_id on drift rows (handler already emits). web/console/pacts/console-ledgercore.json is regenerated by running vitest and must be committed. Run vitest in web/console (all 52 green), then go test -count=1 ./internal/adapters/http after copying libpact_ffi.so to /tmp. Foreground only. Deploy-order risk: server before console. Contract shape: pure-function (read-only client and provider reads).
